pr.title: Point the plan docs at the project commands
pr.head: af4bf2067baad65f94688db02ce33b99b4a00f8b

summary: Projector keeps each project plan in docs/projects/<name>/readme.md, with YAML frontmatter that records the plan's status, priority, and optional owner. The project command line tool (the CLI) reads and changes those fields. The plan documentation still told you to edit the frontmatter by hand, and this repository's docs/projects/README.md still said the CLI had not shipped and searched plans with find and rg.

This pull request rewrites those passages to name the commands. You start a plan with project create, change its fields with project status, project priority, project owner, and project done, and find plans with project list and project search. The change touches three documents, each read by a different audience:

• The template. src/projector/templates/project-readme.md is the docs/projects/README.md that project init writes into a repository that adopts Projector. init writes it once and never rewrites it, so only new adopters get the new text.
  • This repository's plan guide. docs/projects/README.md explains the plan format to people who write plans here.
  • This repository's agent rules. AGENTS.md, which CLAUDE.md links to, holds the rules coding agents follow here. The edit stays above the section that project init generates.

No code changes. The review checked every command and option the new text names against the CLI at this head, and found one problem: AGENTS.md now forbids every hand edit of the frontmatter, though a hand edit is the only way to repair a plan the commands cannot load.

cards.title: Commands the new text names
cards.html:
CommandWhat it does
project create <name>Writes the directory and a readme.md with status: draft and priority: later, unless you pass --status or --priority.
project status, project priorityReplace one frontmatter value and leave the rest of the file as it was.
project ownerSets the owner field, or removes it with --clear.
project doneShorthand for project status <name> completed.
project listGroups plans by priority. --status, --priority, and --owner filter it, and apply together.
project searchMatches names, titles, frontmatter values, and every Markdown file under a project, ignoring case.

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html:
• One open finding on AGENTS.md line 22: the rule says "never" edit the frontmatter, which leaves no repair for a plan the commands refuse to load.
  • The unit suite, project check, both plugin validations, and git diff --check pass at this head.

groups.title: The plan guide that new adopters get
groups.kicker: The template project init writes into an adopting repository
intro: When a repository adopts Projector, project init copies this template to docs/projects/README.md. The template said "Status and priority changes edit frontmatter". It now tells the reader to start a plan with project create and to change the frontmatter with the four field commands rather than by hand. It also names project search beside project list and project check.
init never rewrites the file once it exists, so a repository that already adopted Projector keeps its old text.

files.note: The second and third paragraphs now name the commands.

checks.text: project create writes the directory, a lowercase readme.md, and status and priority frontmatter in the format the first paragraph describes. Checked in ProjectStore.create in src/projector/core.py.
This says "rather than by hand", a preference. AGENTS.md says "never", which is where the open finding sits.

groups.title: This repository's plan guide
intro: docs/projects/README.md explains this repository's plan format. Four passages change:

• Casing. project check already reports an entry point named other than lowercase readme.md, so the note that it would "once the CLI ships" goes.
  • New plans. The guide recommends project create, and keeps hand-written frontmatter for a plan written without it.
  • Field changes. The guide tells you to run project status, project priority, or project done rather than edit the frontmatter.
  • Finding plans. "Find projects before the CLI exists" becomes "Find projects", built on project list and project search. The rename section says Projector has no rename command, so you use git mv.

files.note: Each passage that described the CLI as missing now names the command.

checks.text: This allows a hand edit only to author a new plan. The commands refuse a plan that project check rejects, such as one with an empty owner: line or merge-conflict markers in its frontmatter. So a hand edit is the only repair for that plan, and this sentence does not allow it. The open finding on AGENTS.md line 22 covers both places.

The commands keep the rest of the file and refuse to write when the file changes after they read it. _set_field and set_owner in src/projector/core.py compare the file's inode, size, and modification time before the write and again inside _atomic_write.

--status, --priority, and --owner filter one after another in the list branch of src/projector/cli.py, so a project must match every option. --owner ignores case. project list --priority now ran cleanly at this head.
The CLI has no rename or move command. Checked against project --help at this head.

groups.title: This repository's agent rules
groups.kicker: AGENTS.md tells agents to use the commands
intro: AGENTS.md holds the rules coding agents follow in this repository, and CLAUDE.md is a link to it. The project-model rule said "Change status and priority in frontmatter". It now says to start a project with project create and to change its status, priority, and owner with the commands, "never by editing the frontmatter". The command list below it adds search, create, owner, and done.
The edit stays above the Projector section between the generated markers, which project init renders from agents-block.md. project check reports no edited section at this head.

files.note: The project-model rule and the command list now name the commands.

checks.text: "Never by editing the frontmatter" leaves no repair for a plan the commands cannot load. On a plan with an empty owner: line, project owner demo --clear and project status demo ready both exit 65 with "owner must not be empty; name a person or remove the field". On merge-conflict markers in the frontmatter, project status exits 65 with "malformed frontmatter". The fix is to allow a hand edit to repair such a plan, here and in docs/projects/README.md.
Each listed form parses: project owner <name> --clear, project search <query> --json, project create <name>, and project done <name>. Checked against each command's --help at this head.
